title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Chapter 3 MCQ Revision Notes
description: Revise 100 English and Urdu PowerPoint MCQs for D.I.T Semester 1, organised in ten topics with highlighted answers and a teacher answer key.
content:
## About these PowerPoint notes

This PDF contains the supplied teacher-edition Microsoft PowerPoint conceptual question bank for D.I.T Semester 1 Computer Science. It belongs to the MS Office book as Chapter 3, after Introduction to MS Office and Microsoft Word 2016. The document includes 100 questions in English and Urdu, arranged in ten topics with ten questions per topic. It is practice and revision material, not a replacement for a complete theory textbook.

## Topics in the document

1. Introduction to PowerPoint
2. Startup Screen and Interface
3. Presentation File Management
4. Slide Layouts and Placeholders
5. Slide Management and Views
6. Text, Bullets and Formatting
7. Shapes and Picture Formatting
8. Tables and Charts
9. Transitions and Animations
10. Slide Show, Zoom and Shortcuts

## How to use the question bank

Choose one topic at a time. Read the English question and use the Urdu version to confirm its meaning. Decide your answer before looking at the highlighted option. Then explain why the other three choices do not fit. The teacher answer key at the end follows the same topic order and includes every question from 1 to 100.

## Practise the same topics online

Open [Computer Science MCQs](/classes/dit-intermediate/dit-computer-science/mcqs/), choose MS Office, then Chapter 3: Microsoft PowerPoint and your topic. The interactive test keeps answers hidden until its result stage. The PDF teacher edition deliberately retains the source highlights and answer key for revision.

## Turn the questions into practical skills

Create a short presentation with a title slide and a content slide. Change a layout, duplicate and rearrange a slide, add a picture, format a shape, and insert a simple table or chart. Compare a transition between slides with an animation applied to an object. Finally, rehearse the slide show and practise the keyboard shortcuts from the last topic. These tasks help connect each answer with a visible action in PowerPoint.

## Preview or download

Use the PDF viewer below or download the document for offline study. English and Urdu text, the original option order, highlighted answers and the complete teacher key are preserved. The Urdu font is embedded in the PDF.

## Continue your revision

Visit [Computer Science notes](/classes/dit-intermediate/dit-computer-science/notes/) for the other MS Office and Computer Networking chapters, or return to [subject resources](/classes/dit-intermediate/dit-computer-science/).
